summary: Implemented the Decathalon datalist loader. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py with load_decathalon_datalist (fully type-hinted, Google-style docstring, private helper _resolve_decathalon_path, imports limited to json, os, typing). Added an explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py, a "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection in docs/source/data.rst after the Utilities entry, and tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (test_seg_values, test_cls_values, test_seg_no_basedir, test_seg_no_labels), each removing its temp directory in finally. Not verified: I did not run tests or Black, per instructions. Checked by reading only: no loader line exceeds 120 columns. Nothing committed. Choices made: non-object top-level JSON and non-list key values raise ValueError; malformed JSON propagates json.JSONDecodeError (a ValueError subclass); items lacking image/label pass through unchanged; paths are normalized with os.path.normpath.
